title: An empty period sends nothing and says so
description:
When a periodic list has no qualifying item and no content a person wrote, nothing is sent: the run ends `nothing` with the reason 'no items reached the list's bar', and Today shows it. A list may instead be set to `emptyPeriod: draft_only`, which creates the draft for a person to fill and sends only if a person adds content and the rung allows. No placeholder issue is ever sent.

**Acceptance criteria**
- An empty period produces no email.
- The reason is visible on Today.
- A person's own content makes a period non-empty.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- empty-period.feature: no qualifying items sends nothing and records why; `draft_only` creates a draft and sends nothing by itself; a person's note makes the issue sendable.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Newsletters and subscriptions: weekly, daily and every new item. Slice code N4 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
